svg.aria-label: Ω, eventual leader: Trust the smallest process nobody suspects, and grow the timeout after every mistake.. heartbeats from the leader; a slow heartbeat looks like a crash: change leader; it was wrong: raise the timeout; after GST the heartbeats are on time; the leader crashes; everybody trusts the next smallest, together. The timeout eventually exceeds the real delay, so the mistakes stop and one correct leader remains.
